fields.v: No (0): the authors created both evaluated guidance approaches (probe-and-refine and the static_kb knowledge base); no_context is the bare agent baseline, not an external approach, so no third-party approach is evaluated
fields.quote: no_context measures the agent alone, static_kb adds generic guidance, and probe_refined adds iterative refinement on top.
fields.why: Partly applies when the authors' approach is compared with external ones; here both guidance approaches are the authors' own and no_context is only the bare baseline, so the rule points to No.
fields.doubt: As duas abordagens avaliadas (static_kb e probe_refined) são dos autores; no_context é só o agente sem orientação, não uma abordagem externa. Pela regra, Parcial só quando há abordagens externas. Vê a pág. 4 (§3.2) e decide entre Não (0) e Parcial (0,5).
